questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.**

The newspaper reported / that it was a mystery / how the thieves enter / the house.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **how the thieves enter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Had entered'** should be used instead of **enter**. 
 
• The given sentence is in the **past tense**.
 
• The **past perfect tense **describes one action that happened before another action in the past.
 
• These two tenses are both used to talk about **things that happened in the past.**
 
• However, we use past perfect to talk about **something that happened before another action in the past (had entered)**, which is usually expressed by the past simple** (reported).**
 
• Thus, the option that contains an error is **option 2**. 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *The newspaper reported that it was a mystery how the thieves **__had entered__ **the house.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__***

 
• **'Had entered'** का इस्तेमाल '**enter**' के बजाय किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में पूर्वकालीन काल का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। पूर्वकालीन कालीन कार्रवाई के बारे में बात करने के लिए पुराने मुकदमे की रिपोर्ट के द्वारा व्यक्त की जाने वाली क्रिया होती है।

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

options.text: We should be bidden farewell by our seniors.

• The sentences with which an order, advice or request is expressed are called imperative sentences.

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Kavya said to her husband, “I don’t mind being a busy woman.”

options.text: Kavya told her husband that she had not mind being a busy woman.
Kavya told her husband that she do not mind being a busy woman.
Kavya said to her husband she did not mind being a busy woman.
Kavya told her husband that she did not mind being a busy woman.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Kavya told her husband that she did not mind being a busy woman**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reported speech is given in **Present indefinite tense.** 
 
• If reported verb is in **Past Tense**, reported speech will change from **Present Indefinite Tense to Past Indefinite Tense.**
 
• **Said to **will be changed to **told **and **do not** will be changed to **did not**.
 
• **'I'** in reported speech will be changed to '**she' (according to the speaker).**
 
• Thus, the correct indirect form of the given sentence is** option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Kavya told her husband that she did not mind being a busy woman.*

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. The award is named after Alfred Nobel, the Swedish inventor of dynamite.

Q. A Nobel Prize is an award that is given to someone whose work has benefitted society.

R. This award is given in six categories, and medicine is one of those categories.

S. This year Professors David Julius and Ardem Petapoutian have won this prize for medicine.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **QPRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sentence Q** seems to be first sentence which explains the definition of a Nobel Prize.
 
• The second sentence should be** P **which says that Nobel Prize award is named after Alfred Nobel.
 
• The third sentence should be **sentence** **R **which gives more information about the Nobel Prize that it is given in six categories.
 
• **Sentence S** should be the last sentence which concludes the paragraph with the names of winners of current year.
 
• Thus, the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph is **option 4.** 

**Correct Arrangement:**__ *A Nobel Prize is an award that is given to someone whose work has benefitted society. The award is named after Alfred Nobel, the Swedish inventor of dynamite. This award is given in six categories, and medicine is one of those categories. This year Professors David Julius and Ardem Petapoutian have won this prize for medicine.*
